name: Calendar
description: See and manage your calendar from Antimatter, over CalDAV, and get reminders before events.

settings_schema.header: Users connect their own calendar server over CalDAV. Passwords are stored encrypted; users should use app passwords where their provider offers them.

settings.help_text: When true, the Calendar bot sends users a direct message before their events, at the time of the event's own alarm or, for events without one, the time each user chooses.

settings.display_name: Allow calendar servers on private networks
settings.help_text: When true, users can connect to calendar servers on loopback, private and link-local addresses, such as a calendar server on your internal network. Leave it off unless your calendar server is on such a network: it would also let users reach the other internal services of the network this server runs in.
When true, users can connect to calendar servers over plain HTTP. Their passwords and calendars then cross the network unencrypted.
